text:
Samir: Heads-up — FinServCo wants a POC but with very specific hosting boundaries. They said: 'All inference and storage must stay inside EU or APAC depending on tenant, and no US sub-processors for EU tenants.'
Anya: Got it. Do we have a definitive sub-processor matrix per region we can share? Customer legal asked for full list + certs.
Leo: We have a current mapping doc but it's not customer-ready. Quick answer: EU primary infra in Frankfurt (GCP), backups in Amsterdam; APAC primary in Singapore (AWS AP-Southeast-1). Some monitoring and alerting services run from US regions via vendor telemetry (Datadog, Sentry).
Samir: They explicitly rejected any vendor telemetry hitting US for EU tenants. Maria, can we provide an attestation / workaround?
Maria: Short: we can offer an EU-only deployment path (Dedicated or Private) that excludes those US-hosted SaaS integrations, but it isn't available on Hosted tier by default. That affects pricing and lead time.
Anya: Customer asked about a short POC window (2 weeks). Can we scope a Hosted-but-EU-only POC with sampling turned off for telemetry?
Leo: Hosted runs rely on some central services in US (control plane, billing). We can do a Hosted-like experience via Dedicated capacity in EU with a limited feature set: no external telemetry, no cross-region failover. It'll require a temporary config:
```
routing_policy: REGION_PIN_EU
subprocess_exclusions: [datadog, sentry, mixpanel]
kms_location: eu-west-1
```
Anya: That config snippet is helpful. What about KMS/subproc certs? They asked for cert chain + ISO27001 for each vendor.
Maria: For Dedicated/Private we can provide keystore in-customer-region and a subproc list with cert references. For Hosted (standard) we can only provide the generic subproc list; some vendors are US-based so won't satisfy them.
Samir: And pricing? Customer expects Hosted POC pricing but if we push them to Dedicated, they'll want credits. Any quick ballpark for a 2-week EU-dedicated POC with 2 gpus reserved?
Leo: Ballpark: ~$6k — includes reserved nodes + networking + temporary ops on-call. If we keep it minimal (no egress to US, default quantization), maybe $4k. Need finance approval.
Anya: I'll flag both options in the quote: Hosted (fastest, but fails EU-only ask) vs EU-Dedicated POC (meets residency, higher cost, 1wk lead).
ops-bot: FYI — ticket INFRA-8923 created for EU Dedicated POC provisioning (ETA 5 business days).
Samir: Customer also asked about fallback routing: if EU capacity exhausted, will requests ever go to US? We must confirm a hard no for EU tenants.
Leo: If we pin tenant to EU (REGION_PIN_EU) and disable failover, requests stay in EU. Caveat: disaster recovery/DR runs are separate and would require an exception. We can put that in the contract as 'no automatic cross-border failover during POC'.
Maria: I'll draft a short contract clause: 'During the POC term, Redwood will enforce region pinning and exclude specified sub-processors; no cross-border processing will occur absent signed exception.'
Samir: Perfect. Last ask — they want a contact for SOC2/ISO docs and a timeline for ops handoff post-POC.
Anya: I'll attach the security pack and ops handoff checklist in the next message and loop in SolutionsEng for runbooks.
Maria: I'll attach the draft clause and subproc matrix PDF once Leo confirms the list.
Leo: Working on the subproc matrix now — will include provider cert links. ETA: end of day.
Samir: Thanks team. I'll update the customer: propose EU-dedicated POC w/ 2 options and estimated cost, plus contract clause and subproc matrix to follow. :thumbsup:
Anya: +1. Keep me on cc for pricing and quote language.
Maria: cc me for clause review.
ops-bot: Reminder set: follow up in 48 hours on INFRA-8923.
